guidance.bestFor: The minimal markup: 6 slots split 3 and 3 by one separator, accepting any character

whenNotToUse.when: A numeric code whose slots should refuse letters as they are typed
A full verification step with a resend action and a submit button

guidance.bestFor: One unbroken row of 6 slots that refuses anything but digits
agentNotes: `REGEXP_ONLY_DIGITS` drops a pasted code whole when a space or dash sits inside it; strip them with the pasteTransformer prop

whenNotToUse.when: A short PIN of 4 digits with a hint line under its label

guidance.bestFor: A controlled value prefilled with 123456, shown as 3 pairs between 2 separators
agentNotes: `value` starts as the sample 123456 in `useState`; start it as an empty string so the slots load blank

name: c-input-otp-4
title: OTP input with letters and numbers.
label: Letters & Numbers
description: OTP input with letters and numbers.

guidance.bestFor: A 6 character code that takes letters and digits but refuses symbols, with a hint between label and slots
agentNotes: `input-otp` defaults inputMode to numeric, so phones open a number pad; set inputMode to text on `InputOTP` so letters can be typed

whenNotToUse.when: A code made only of digits, shown in a single unbroken row

guidance.bestFor: A 4 slot PIN in one group, digits only, with a short hint above the slots
agentNotes: Each `InputOTPSlot` prints its `char` in plain view; mask a PIN with a custom slot that shows a dot in its place
`input-otp` sets autocomplete to one-time-code, so phones offer SMS codes here; pass autoComplete off to `InputOTP` for a PIN

whenNotToUse.when: A longer 6 digit one time code rather than a short PIN

guidance.bestFor: A login check Card naming the email the code went to, with wider slots, a Resend Code button and a full width Verify
agentNotes: The Verify `Button` sits in `CardFooter` outside the `form`, so it submits nothing; move it inside and handle the code in onSubmit
The Resend Code `Button` has no handler, and on the radix twin it is the `form` submit button since it sets no type
`CardDescription` prints the sample address m@example.com; show the address the code was really sent to

whenNotToUse.when: A bare code field with no Card, resend action or submit around it
